scope: A matched fixed-seed control and scheduled-change pair on one accepted stock-based TEACH-DU-01 reorder at DEPOT-01. Nominal depot stock is four, initial on-hand three, and initial ROSIZ two. The child alone schedules ROSIZ one at hour five, before the inherited hour-ten ordinary demand. No transfer is introduced in this pair.

E02.accepted_scope: One zero-local-stock backorder and repair return, not stock reorder.

E15.accepted_scope: Tracked DU depot STSIZ four, ROSIZ two, explicit ISTOH three; one hour-ten demand and two-unit reorder with one-hour lead. This is the direct source parent, not acceptance of the catalog's above-nominal E15.var07 boundary.

I02_IN.accepted_scope: One zero-delay IN transfer and station-specific nominal/on-hand stock ledger.

I02_BETWEEN.accepted_scope: One zero-delay BETWEEN transfer after IN, with depot/base physical and nominal stock ledgers. No transfer is reused by this experiment.

source.manual_boundary: ChangesStockAllocation may change only ROSIZ for an existing POINT/IID/STID stock row. The change itself does not place an order; the next demand or scheduled transfer reapplies the strategy. The first subsequent order may exceed the new ROSIZ. Stock state includes on-hand, outstanding reorders and transfers; nominal STSIZ and actual on-hand are distinct.

environment.execution: Unique immutable run directory; session-0 loopback SSH with sshd ancestor; nonblocking Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue mutex; no concurrent native job; GUI identity checked before and after each hidden CLI child.

frozen_source.parent_delta: Both arms change the parent description to the same text and add an otherwise identical six-column ChangesStockAllocation table immediately after StockAllocation. The control has one all-null placeholder; the child has POINT AIR_BASIC, IID TEACH-DU-01, STID DEPOT-01, TIMEC five, ROSIZ one, NOTE null. All 31 inherited tables, including initial StockAllocation and ItemReorder, are unchanged except shared description.
frozen_source.paired_delta: The only value difference between the two frozen inputs is the ChangesStockAllocation row: all-null control versus one scheduled ROSIZ=1 row.

report_selector.purpose: Select TEACH-DU-01 at DEPOT-01 ItemResults and mission tables in each arm.

predeclared_gates: Before native execution, an independent reviewer confirms source, parent, manual, dictionary and pair-diff pins; the runner is frozen and a unique run ID is unoccupied.

Both arms import and export with exact 22 row-containing-table roundtrip before calculation. Converter summary is Errors0/Warnings1/Notes0 with sole #108 logging warning, matching the accepted direct parent; any other diagnostic excludes the run. Both arms require valid nonempty SXO, event log and selected report. The protected GUI survives every native child.

The change arm has no reorder between hour five and the inherited hour-ten demand, and no physical or nominal stock movement caused by the scheduled change alone. The control is checked on the same interval.

After the hour-ten demand, enumerate every reorder start, size, completion, arrival and physical item identity in each arm. Do not assume the child's first batch equals the new ROSIZ of one; a first batch larger than one is permitted only if its native event and stock-state ledger reconcile.

Across all 72 half-hour selected depot ItemResults bins per arm, reconcile STSZ, STOHA, NRO, ordinary demand/backorder and terminal stock with the full raw event ledger, including shipments to the base, outstanding orders and arrivals. Reconcile mission, system and aggregate stock results to accepted E15 scope.

If both arms are observationally identical, the conclusion may cover scheduled-row acceptance and no-immediate-order behavior only; it must not claim a demonstrated new batch policy. Any import, report, ledger, identity or event discrepancy is a failed predeclared gate retained under its immutable run ID.
limits: One fixed seed, one DU stock-based reorder point, one ordinary demand, h5 ROSIZ 2-to-1 change and a 36-hour horizon; no time-based reorder, multiple outstanding orders, random lead, transfer at the change time, other stations or seeds.
The control and change remain matched in initial stock and business events; CLI-only evidence does not verify GUI display or cross-engine semantics.
A publication based on this experiment cannot close full I07.var02 or Issue #18 without evidence of the broader catalog boundary.
